title: claudetui.Daemon thin-client-ification (socket attach + screen restore)
design_refs: docs/no-halt-agent-design.md#4-既存コードからの移行マップ

acceptance_scenarios.intent: Daemon no longer owns the PTY; it socket-attaches to a ptyhost. Emulator/roleCoordinator/respawn(exit→new ptyhost + --resume decision)/hooks/gateRespawn stay in palmux2 (migration map §4).
steps: Assert spawnWithArgs no longer calls creackpty.Start directly; instead it builds full argv/env (hooks settings, --permission-mode, incus wrapper via PTYCommander, --plugin-dir) EXACTLY as today and hands it to the ptyhost launcher (Story 1).
Assert the Daemon's readLoop now reads DATA frames from the socket (not a PTY fd) and still does (ring.Write + emulator.Feed) under feedMu.
Assert WriteInput sends INPUT frames and Resize sends RESIZE frames over the socket.
Assert Emulator, roleCoordinator, feedMu, RenderSnapshotAndSubscribe, SetSessionID/SessionWatcher, gateRespawn, hooks.go stay on the palmux2 side (still referenced by Daemon; not moved into ptyhost).
Integration: with a real ptyhost holding a fake child, attach the Daemon, feed bytes, assert emulator grid reflects them and a WS client sees the rendered snapshot.
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Daemon is a thin socket client; all orchestration stays in palmux2 per §4.

acceptance_scenarios.intent: After palmux2 restart, reconnect restores the pre-restart TUI screen AND output produced during the restart window is not lost. Restore = ring replay → Emulator feed → SIGWINCH jiggle; no stale frame residue.
steps: Start dev instance `make serve INSTANCE=dev`. Open a claude-tui tab; let claude render a distinctive screen (e.g. run a command whose output + status line are visible). Record the visible text via the grid snapshot / xterm buffer.
Have claude produce CONTINUOUS output (a running turn, e.g. a long `for i in $(seq ...); do echo ...; sleep` inside claude's Bash, or feed the fake child a stream) so bytes flow DURING the restart.
Restart ONLY the dev palmux2 (`make serve INSTANCE=dev` re-run kills+restarts the dev instance — NEVER the host). ptyhost survives (Story 1).
Reconnect the browser/WS to the dev instance; assert the restore path ran: ring ATTACH from head offset → Emulator re-fed → RESIZE(cols,rows-1) then RESIZE(cols,rows) jiggle observed.
Assert the previously-visible conversation + status line are visible again in the reattached grid.
Assert output emitted DURING the restart window appears (compare a sentinel counter printed across the gap — no missing lines).
Assert NO stale-frame residue after the jiggle (the grid equals a freshly-rendered screen, not overlapping fragments).
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Screen restored, in-flight-turn output preserved, no residue. Matches §5 acceptance criteria.

acceptance_scenarios.intent: protocol-version-mismatch ptyhost is NOT killed; palmux2 surfaces a UI-degrade state ('old-gen agent host — restart to enable new features').
steps: Simulate a ptyhost whose HELLO reports an older protocol version than the Daemon expects.
Assert the Daemon does NOT send SHUTDOWN / does NOT kill the ptyhost.
Assert the Daemon exposes a degrade flag (e.g. in CurrentStats / a status field consumed by the existing tab status channel) indicating 'old-gen agent host'.
Assert minimal-compat INPUT/DATA still flow where possible; where not, the state instructs 'restart & reconnect'.
(No pixel test — this story is go-library-cli; the degrade STATE is asserted, existing frontend renders it.)
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Version skew degrades gracefully; ptyhost preserved; degrade state observable.

acceptance_scenarios.intent: Existing claude-tui unit/E2E (multi-client role, hook notification, resize, respawn --resume) regress cleanly.
steps: Run the full claudetui unit suite (daemon_test, multiclient_test, role, ring_test, emulator_test, render_snapshot_test, manager_integration_test, daemon_gate_test, hooks_test, sessions_test) — all pass, adapting fakes to the socket path where a test previously assumed a direct PTY.
Assert multi-client active/viewer role coordination still works over the new attach path.
Assert hook notification injection (settings/env via argv to ptyhost) is byte-identical to today's payload.

Assert respawn-on-death with --resume still works: kill the child inside the ptyhost → ptyhost exits → Daemon detects exit (STATUS/disconnect) → spawns a NEW ptyhost with --resume <sid>, gated by gateRespawn.
Assert resize propagation reaches the child.
acceptance_scenarios.expected: No regression across the existing claudetui behaviors.

notes: This is the core migration and the highest-risk story. daemon.go is substantially rewritten (PTY ownership removed). Keep the exact argv/env assembly (hooks, --permission-mode, incus PTYCommand wrapper, --plugin-dir) so hook payload + in-container spawn are unchanged. The 'respawn = spawn new ptyhost' shape replaces the in-process re-exec but keeps gateRespawn / bad-transcript guard / --resume logic. §5 SIGWINCH jiggle is the convergence mechanism — if a TUI state fails to converge, that is an ADR-0002 revisit trigger (escalate at milestone).
